title: Phase 8 — choose the visual world for AI Business OS
question: The roll assigned the Annual Report identity for the app. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Tenant workspaces will tint the accent and type mood from their own logo and industry on top of whichever world you pick; status colours stay fixed.

options.label: The Annual Report
options.lineage: Philippine listed-company annual reports and their identity programs
options.thesis: Every number the agents produce is set like an audited figure, with a note that leads to its evidence.
materials: confident grotesk numerals at report scale
deep green shell on cool paper white
options.viewport: Green side rail with the workspace's logo; Control Center leads with three report-scale figures (tasks completed, awaiting approval, month spend), each carrying a superscript note key; the notes column on the right lists the evidence each key points to.
options.risk: Can read like a static PDF if the notes are decorative rather than live links into evidence.

raised.raise: Budgets and limits are drawn as a fill against a hard capacity (monthly budget, runs per day), never as an unbounded number.
Run and action states carry a glyph and a word as well as a colour: solid done, dashed pending, struck refused.
Setup and readiness show only the next decision ahead and what it unlocks.
The approval inbox puts one held action in full focus with the next one queued behind it.

options.label: Official Receipt & Approval Stamp
options.lineage: BIR official receipts, numbered OR series and office rubber stamps
options.thesis: Approvals land like a dated rubber stamp and every piece of evidence carries a serial number, the way Filipino offices already prove things happened.
materials: form-stock ground with printed field rules
options.viewport: Navy top bar; approval inbox leads, each held action a numbered form with its exact parameters; deciding drops a dated APPROVED or REJECTED stamp with the approver's initials.
options.risk: Familiar from government paperwork; the stamp must stay a signature moment, not cover every screen.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.lineage: wide-margin reference editions with a keyed centre rail
options.thesis: Daily reports set as reference pages: two columns of findings, vermilion evidence keys on a centre rail, apparatus in the margin.
materials: hairline ruling at one device pixel
options.viewport: A daily report as two columns of findings around a rail of evidence keys, the margin holding the linked runs.
options.case: Holds product clarity for reports and evidence; loses audience identification with busy SMB owners on phones.
options.risk: Reads as a book, not a tool, on dense operational screens.

options.label: Warm Consumer App Surface
options.lineage: friendly consumer apps (e-wallets, delivery apps) Filipino owners use daily
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground, plain-language labels, one action colour only where something can be done.
options.viewport: Card stack: approvals waiting, today's runs, budget; the one green action on each card.
options.case: Wins audience identification on phones; loses product clarity for dense governance tables and evidence.
options.risk: Undersells control and auditability; looks like a consumer app.

options.label: Vertical Media Feed
options.thesis: One item owns the viewport; the next is one snap away.
options.case: Loses both axes: governance needs comparison and tables.
options.kept: One held action in full focus at a time in the approval inbox.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.thesis: Two sides that must not overflow the tape.
options.viewport: Side A / side B task lists.
options.case: Loses both axes: nostalgic, not operational.
options.kept: Hard capacity: budgets and limits shown as fill against a fixed length.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: Each junction shows only the choices ahead.
options.viewport: Setup as a chain of signed junctions.
options.kept: Show only the next decision ahead in setup and readiness.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: State carried by line form, not hue.
options.viewport: Agents as ticks on one rail.
options.case: Loses both axes: too abstract for owners.
options.risk: Night-lab mood in a daytime office.
options.kept: States carry shape and words as well as colour.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS admin: white surfaces, slate text, one blue accent, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI cards, tables — the arrangement every admin expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI-agent dashboard by design.
